evidence.summary: README: write notes in Markdown, tag them, and search all text.
notes table: integer autoincrement id, title text not null, body text not null, created_at timestamp not null.
list (ordered by created_at desc), create, update and delete note handlers.
tags table with unique name; note_tags join table with FKs to notes and tags, both on delete cascade.
tag_note gets or creates a tag by name and inserts a note_tags row.
search matches the text as a LIKE substring against title OR body (comment calls it full-text).
preview renders the Markdown body to HTML with markdown.render, for a preview pane.
ROUTES map: GET/POST /notes, PUT/DELETE /notes/<id>, POST /notes/<id>/tags, GET /search, GET /notes/<id>/preview.
Header says Flask-style, illustrative handlers; imports render from the markdown package.

database: SQL relational database (autoincrement syntax suggests SQLite; inferred)

architecture.frontend: Not present in the source folder; a preview pane is mentioned in a code comment only.
architecture.backend: Single Python module of HTTP handlers over a relational schema via a db helper object that is not in the folder.

features.name: Note CRUD
features.description: Create, list, edit and delete notes with a title and a Markdown body.
features.observed_behaviour: GET /notes returns all notes newest first by created_at; POST /notes inserts title and body; PUT /notes/<id> updates title and body; DELETE /notes/<id> deletes.
features.business_logic: title and body are NOT NULL; list order created_at desc; deleting a note cascades its note_tags rows.

features.name: Tags
features.description: Attach named tags to notes; tags are shared, unique by name.
features.observed_behaviour: POST /notes/<id>/tags gets or creates the tag by name and links it to the note.
features.business_logic: tag name unique; many-to-many via note_tags; cascades on note or tag delete. No duplicate check on the note_tags pair (observed: plain insert, no unique constraint).

features.name: Search title and body
features.description: Find notes whose title or body contains the search text.
features.observed_behaviour: GET /search runs LIKE '%text%' on title OR body.
features.business_logic: substring match on both fields; case sensitivity depends on the database (SQLite LIKE is case-insensitive for ASCII; inferred).

features.name: Markdown preview
features.description: Render a note's Markdown body to HTML for a preview pane.
features.business_logic: Rendered HTML; no sanitisation step is visible.
features.integration: Needs a Markdown renderer; output should be sanitised in the unified app.

auth.model: no authentication or authorization in the code

error_handling.case: missing note id on update, delete, tag or preview
error_handling.behaviour: not handled in the handlers; depends on the db helper (unknown)
rejected by the NOT NULL constraint only for NULL; empty strings are accepted (inferred from schema)
